title: 【悲報】推しが消えたので、遺言に従って初恋を完遂させる件について
author: ネオ・カナタ

en.title: Sad News: After My Idol Disappeared, I Followed Her Will to Fulfill My First Love
en.premise: The school’s top charismatic streamer, Nagi, suddenly deletes all her accounts and vanishes. I receive a “digital will” from her—a quest that feels like a crappy game. If I clear every condition, I can meet her. Following the rule, I get swept into an online frenzy while heading toward the “Promised Hill” she set.

zh.title: 【悲报】我的偶像消失后，我按遗嘱完成初恋的事
zh.premise: 学校最具魅力的直播主凪（Nagi）突然删除所有账号并失踪。随后我收到她留下的“数字遗嘱”——一场像糟糕游戏一样的任务。只要完成所有条件，就能与她相见。遵循规则，我在网络风暴中被卷入，最终前往她指定的“約束の丘”。
